function t1.value143()

        return t1.value128.ManualBase
    end

    local v861 = t1.value75()
    local v862

    if not v861 then
        v862 = nil
    else
        local ok25, result24 = pcall(function()
            return v861:GetPivot()
        end)

        v862 = ok25 and result24 or nil
    end

    return v862 and v862.Position or nil
end
function t1.value144()
    local Character = t1.value9.Character
    local v866 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not v866 then
        return
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local v869 = descendant

        if v869:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
            local Parent = v869.Parent

            if Parent and Parent:IsA("BasePart") and (Parent.Position - v866.Position).Magnitude <= 50 then
                pcall(function()
                    if fireproximityprompt then
                        fireproximityprompt(v869)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end
function t1.value145()
    if t1.value132 then
        t1.value132:Disconnect()
        t1.value132 = nil
    end
end
v4(function()
    while t1.value17() do
        t1.value3.Heartbeat:Wait()

        if t1.value128.SpeedChanger and t1.value128.HumReady then
            local v860 = t1.value22()

            if v860 and v860.Health > 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    if v860.WalkSpeed ~= t1.value128.SpeedValue then
                        v860.WalkSpeed = t1.value128.SpeedValue
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)
v4(function()
    while t1.value17() do
        t1.value3.Heartbeat:Wait()

        if t1.value128.AutoSteal and t1.value23() and (t1.value141() and not t1.value135) then
            t1.value135 = true
            local success, result = pcall(function()
                local v1100 = t1.value143()

                if not v1100 then
                    t1.value18("Auto Steal Free", "No base set! Walk to your pen and tap Set Base Here.")

                    return
                end

                t1.value142(v1100, t1.value131)

                for _ = 1, 2 do
                    if pcall(t1.value89, t1.value136 or "") then
                        break
                    end

                    task.wait(0.2)
                end

                for _, v in ipairs(t1.value32(t1.value75(), {
					"place",
					"drop",
					"put"
				})) do
                    local v1104 = v.Parent and (v.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and v.Parent.Position)

                    if v41(v1104, 12) and t1.value30(v) then
                        task.wait(0.15)

                        return
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not success then
                warn("[ShardFree] " .. tostring(result))
            end
            task.delay(1.5, function()
                t1.value135 = false
            end)
        end
    end
end)
t1.value146 = nil
function t1.value146(p124)
    t1.value128.AutoSteal = p124

    if p124 then
        if not t1.value132 then
            t1.value3.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if t1.value128.AutoSteal then
                    t1.value144()
                end
            end)
        end

        if not t1.value128.ManualBase then
            t1.value18("Auto Steal Free", "Tip: walk to your pen and tap Set Base Here first!")
        end
    else
        t1.value145()
    end

    if t1.value134 then
        t1.value134()
    end
end

            t1.value51()

    end)

t1.value12.TabConfig:Button({
	Title = "Copy Place Source",
	Desc = "Reads the game's own egg placement module so the exact call is known",
	Callback = function()
    task.spawn(function()
        local t45 = {}
        local v1203 = type(decompile) == "function"

        local function v1204(p151)
            local t46 = {}
            local ok37, result36 = pcall(debug.getconstants, p151)

            if ok37 then
                ok37 = type(result36) == "table"
            end

            if ok37 then
                for _, v in ipairs(result36) do
                    if type(v) == "string" and #v < 48 then
                        t46[#t46 + 1] = v
                    end
                end
            end

            return t46
        end

        if v1203 then
            local n30 = 0

            for _, descendant in ipairs(t1.value6:GetDescendants()) do
                if n30 >= 4 then
                    break
                end

                if descendant:IsA("ModuleScript") or descendant:IsA("LocalScript") then
                    local v1208 = descendant.Name:lower()

                    if v1208:find("egg") or (v1208:find("plac") or (v1208:find("build") or v1208:find("plot"))) then
                        local ok38, result37 = pcall(decompile, descendant)

                        if ok38 and (type(result37) == "string" and result37:find("PlantEgg", 1, true)) or result37:find("AskPlaceEgg", 1, true) then
                            n30 += 1
                            pcall(writefile, "ShardPlace_" .. descendant.Name .. ".txt", result37)

                            local v1211 = #t45 + 1
                            local FullName = descendant:GetFullName()
                            local v1213 = result37:find("PlantEgg", 1, true)
                            local v1214 = " ==\n" .. if not v1213 then nil else result37:sub(math.max(1, v1213 - 1500), v1213 + 900)

                            if not v1214 then
                                local v1215 = result37:find("AskPlaceEgg", 1, true)

                                v1214 = ((if not v1215 then nil else result37:sub(math.max(1, v1215 - 1500), v1215 + 900))) or result37:sub(1, 2200)
                            end

                            t45[v1211] = "== " .. FullName .. v1214
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if type(getgc) == "function" and (type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.getconstants) == "function") then
            local timestamp = tick()
            local n31 = 0
            local n32 = 0
            local u1219 = timestamp
            pcall(function()
                local g1273
                local v1272
                for _, v in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
                    if n31 >= 4 then
                        return
                    end

                    n32 += 1

                    if n32 > 400000 or tick() - u1219 > 5 then
                        return
                    end

                    if type(v) == "function" then
                        local v1269 = v1204(v)

                        for _, v11 in ipairs(v1269) do
                            if v11 == "PlantEgg" then
                                v1272 = true
                                g1273 = true
                            end

                            if g1273 then
                                break
                            end
                        end

                        if not g1273 then
                            v1272 = false
                        end

                        g1273 = false

                        if v1272 then
                            n31 += 1

                            local s4 = "?"
                            local ok39, result38 = pcall(function()
                                return debug.getinfo(v)
                            end)

                            if ok39 then
                                ok39 = type(result38) == "table"
                            end

                            if ok39 then
                                local _tostring = tostring
                                local short_src = result38.short_src

                                if not short_src then
                                    short_src = result38.source or "?"
                                end

                                s4 = _tostring(short_src) .. ":" .. tostring(result38.linedefined or "?")
                            end

                            t45[#t45 + 1] = "PlantEgg caller " .. n31 .. " [" .. s4 .. "] consts: " .. table.concat(v1269, ",")

                            if type(debug.getprotos) == "function" then
                                local ok40, result39 = pcall(debug.getprotos, v)

                                if ok40 then
                                    ok40 = type(result39) == "table"
                                end

                                if ok40 then
                                    for _, v12 in ipairs(result39) do
                                        t45[#t45 + 1] = "  proto consts: " .. table.concat(v1204(v12), ",")
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            if v1203 then
                                local ok41, result40 = pcall(decompile, v)

                                if ok41 then
                                    ok41 = type(result40) == "string" and #result40 > 0
                                end

                                if ok41 then
                                    t45[#t45 + 1] = "  caller src:\n" .. result40:sub(1, 1800)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if n31 == 0 then
                t45[#t45 + 1] = "no PlantEgg caller in getgc (scanned " .. n32 .. ")"
            end
        end

        local v1220 = t1.value6:FindFirstChild("Client") and t1.value6.Client:FindFirstChild("EggState") or nil

        if not v1220 then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(t1.value6:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant.Name == "EggState" and descendant:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                    v1220 = descendant

                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if v1220 and v1203 then
            local ok42, result41 = pcall(decompile, v1220)

            if ok42 then
                ok42 = type(result41) == "string" and #result41 > 0
            end

            if ok42 then
                pcall(writefile, "ShardEggState.txt", result41)

                local v1225 = #t45 + 1
                local v1226 = result41:find("AskPlaceEgg", 1, true)

                t45[v1225] = "== EggState ==\n" .. (if not v1226 then nil else result41:sub(math.max(1, v1226 - 1500), v1226 + 900)) or result41:sub(1, 1200)
            end
        end

        if #t45 == 0 then
            t45[#t45 + 1] = "decompile + introspection unavailable on this executor"
        end

        local v1227 = table.concat(t45, "\n\n")

        if setclipboard then
            pcall(setclipboard, v1227)
        end

        if writefile then
            pcall(writefile, "ShardPlaceSrc.txt", v1227)
        end

        t1.value18("Place Source", "Copied. Saved ShardPlaceSrc.txt + per-module files.", 6)
    end)
end

t1.value151 = {
	spawned = {},
	orbitRadius = 4,
	orbitSpeed = 0.8,
	conn = nil,

t1.value152 = Instance.new("Folder")
t1.value152.Name = "ShardVisualPets"
t1.value152.Parent = t1.value7
function t1.value153()
    local t47 = {}
    local t48 = {}
    local function v954(p152)
        if not p152:IsA("Model") then
            return
        end

        local v1229 = p152.Name:lower()

        if v1229:find("humanoid") or v1229:find("egg") then
            return
        end

        local v1230 = p152:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") ~= nil
        local v1231 = p152.Parent and p152.Parent.Name:lower() or ""

        if (v1230 and v1231:find("pet") or (v1231:find("pen") or (v1231:find("render") or (v1231:find("slot") or p152:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AnimationController"))))) and not t47[p152.Name] then
            t47[p152.Name] = true
            t48[#t48 + 1] = p152.Name
        end
    end
    for v957, v958 in ipairs(t1.value102()) do

        local GetDescendants = v958.GetDescendants

        for _, v in ipairs(GetDescendants(v958)) do
            v954(v)
        end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(t1.value7:GetChildren()) do
        for _, child3 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
            v954(child3)
        end
    end
    table.sort(t48)
    t1.value151.petNames = t48

    return t48
end
function t1.value154(p153)
    local v967 = p153:lower()
    for v970, v971 in ipairs(t1.value102()) do

        for _, descendant in ipairs(v971:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.Name:lower():find(v967, 1, true) and descendant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
                return descendant
            end
        end
    end
    for _, descendant in ipairs(t1.value7:GetDescendants()) do
        local v976 = descendant:IsA("Model")

        if v976 then
            v976 = descendant.Name:lower():find(v967, 1, true)

            if v976 then
                v976 = not descendant:IsDescendantOf(t1.value152)
            end
        end

        if v976 and descendant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
            return descendant
        end
    end

    return nil
end
function t1.value155(p154)
    local v982 = t1.value154(p154)
    if not v982 then
        t1.value18("Visual Pets", "Could not find a model named: " .. p154, 4)

        return
    end
    local clone = v982:Clone()
    for v986, v987 in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do

        if v987:IsA("Script") or (v987:IsA("LocalScript") or v987:IsA("ModuleScript")) then
            v987:Destroy()
        end
    end
    for _, descendant in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            descendant.Anchored = true
            descendant.CanCollide = false
            descendant.CanTouch = false
            descendant.CastShadow = false
        end
    end
    clone.Name = "VP_" .. p154
    clone.Parent = t1.value152
    local v990 = #t1.value151.spawned * (6.283185307179586 / math.max(1, #t1.value151.spawned + 1))
    t1.value151.spawned[#t1.value151.spawned + 1] = {
		model = clone,
		angle = v990
	}
    t1.value18("Visual Pets", "Spawned " .. p154 .. " (client only).", 3)
end
function t1.value156()
    for _, v in ipairs(t1.value151.spawned) do
        local v980 = v

        pcall(function()
            v980.model:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    t1.value151.spawned = {}
end
function t1.value157()
    if #t1.value151.spawned == 0 then
        return
    end

    local v977 = table.remove(t1.value151.spawned)

    pcall(function()
        v977.model:Destroy()
    end)
end
t1.value151.conn = t1.value3.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_)
    local v992 = t1.value21()

    if not v992 or #t1.value151.spawned == 0 then
        return
    end

    local timestamp = tick()
    local v994 = v992.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    local v995 = #t1.value151.spawned

    for i, v in ipairs(t1.value151.spawned) do
        local v998 = v
        local v999 = (i - 1) * (6.283185307179586 / v995) + timestamp * t1.value151.orbitSpeed
        local v1000 = math.cos(v999) * t1.value151.orbitRadius
        local v1001 = math.sin(v999) * t1.value151.orbitRadius
        local v1002 = v994 + Vector3.new(v1000, 0, v1001)

        if v998.model.PrimaryPart or v998.model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                v998.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(v1002) * CFrame.Angles(0, v999 + 3.141592653589793, 0))
            end)
        end
    end
end)
